channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Borges: Flávio e Lula não fizeram nem golaços, nem gols contra na Globo
item.description: Alexandre Borges assessed that the sabatina interviews of Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula on Globo did not have 'any disaster', ending without 'either a home run or an own goal'. The analysis was made during a coverage presented by Natália Mota.

item.title: Na Globo, Flávio erra sobre 'Dark Horse' e ao citar documentário de Lula
item.description: In a Globo interview, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) made factual errors claiming the 'Dark Horse' producer had accounted for all costs and that Federal Police confirmed a R$30 million payment to a Lula documentary by Vorcaro. His statements, lacking immediate factual backing, sparked criticism for spreading misinformation during the campaign.

item.title: Casado: Flávio se diferenciou do pai, mas deixou perguntas sem resposta
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro distinguished himself from his father by adopting a more moderate stance during a Globo interview, but repeated campaign points and avoided direct answers. Letícia Casado noted the candidate made accusations without providing concrete responses, leaving questions unanswered.

item.title: TV Cultura transmite debate entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula neste domingo (18)
item.description: On Sunday (October 18), TV Cultura broadcasts at 8 PM the first direct electoral debate between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), live at Band's studios, with pre-debate coverage starting at 7:30 PM featuring 'De Olho no Voto' and post-debate analysis at 10 PM. The debate will be pooled by five media outlets including Band, Estadão, Gazeta, and Jovem Pan, along with radio broadcasts on Cultura Brasil (77.9 FM) and Cultura FM (103.3 FM).

item.title: Em sabatina, Flávio não explica propostas e faz acusações sem provas
item.description: In a TV Globo interview, Flávio Bolsonaro avoided detailing policy proposals and downplayed the January 8th events, calling them a farce. He denied a coup attempt and defended donation requests without clearly explaining his stance on economy, education, and security.

item.title: “O cara tá afiado”: aliados elogiam Flávio após entrevista à “Globo”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's allies celebrated his performance in the TV Globo interview, praising his calm demeanor and assertive answers. The interview took place nine days before the runoff election on October 25, where he will face Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Lawmakers and commentators commended Flávio, particularly on public security, while criticizing interviewer Renata Lo Prete.

item.title: “Motoboy”: Flávio repete estratégia de Bolsonaro e usa cola na mão
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) replicated his father's strategy by writing 'motoboy' on his hand during a TV Globo interview. The gesture referenced a meeting with delivery workers, a category he promised to support. He had previously used similar tactics in past campaigns.

item.title: Centrão tenta chegar a acordo para votar novo sistema eleitoral e conter avanço da direita
item.description: Center-right parties in Brazil are discussing electoral reform to curb the growth of the PL, which elected 112 deputies. Proposed models include a mixed district system and majoritarian districts, aiming to reduce the advantage of high-vote candidates. The initiative faces resistance from the PL and internal disagreements among allies, complicating electoral reform approval in this legislative term.

item.title: ‘Dark Horse’: PF aponta divergência ‘severa’ entre recursos enviados ao exterior e os que retornaram ao Brasil para filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police found a severe accounting discrepancy between the $12 million sent abroad and the $2.8 million that returned to Brazil to fund the film 'Dark Horse', a Biographical movie about Jair Bolsonaro. Investigators are probing whether the funds were misappropriated under the guise of the film's production.

item.title: Jovens intensificam mobilização para conquistar votos para Lula e Flávio no segundo turno
item.description: Young people aged 16 to 24 are intensifying mobilizations in support of Lula and Flávio ahead of the runoff, occupying universities and social media to influence undecided voters. They act as message multipliers among peers using strategies such as stickers, protests, and digital content. The goal is to reduce abstention and engage new voters in the decisive phase.

item.title: Mirassol vence o Internacional e se distancia do Z-4
item.description: Mirassol defeated Internacional 2-0 with goals from Eduardo and André Luís in the 31st round of the Brazilian Championship. The victory secured the Lion 36 points, staying clear of relegation, while the Colombian team dropped to 32 points, remaining in the relegation zone. Goalkeeper Matheus Cunha was sent off in the first half, but Mirassol dominated the second half.

item.title: Datafolha: 59% defendem que ministros do STF deveriam ter mandato
item.description: A Datafolha survey shows that 59% of Brazilians support establishing a fixed term for Supreme Court ministers, replacing lifetime tenure up to age 75. Additionally, 65% favor ending individual ministerial decisions and 52% support reducing the privileged jurisdiction for politicians. These proposals have backing from voters of both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with minor percentage variations.

item.title: Datafolha: Brasil vive polarização política para 78%
item.description: A Datafolha survey released on October 16, 2026, shows that 78% of Brazilians believe the country is experiencing political polarization, with society divided into opposing views. The perception is higher among college-educated voters (93%) and young people aged 16 to 24 (85%). The survey was conducted with 2,520 people in 153 cities between October 13 and 14, 2026.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro na Globo: o que disse o candidato à Presidência na 2ª entrevista à emissora
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) gave an interview to TV Globo, promising a 'war' on drug trafficking and stating he won't reverse the 6x1 scale. He will face Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the second round on October 25, holding a slight 2-point lead in voter intention polls.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que 'contrato não foi cumprido' ao responder por que pediu R$ 134 milhões a Vorcaro para filme que custou R$ 75 milhões
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated in an interview with TV Globo that a contract related to the funding of the film 'Dark Horse' was not fulfilled, when asked about R$134 million requested from Daniel Vorcaro. The Federal Police are investigating possible money laundering and corruption charges.

item.title: Flávio nega Eduardo como chanceler e diz que Jair não pediu cargo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that his father, Jair Bolsonaro, never requested a position in a potential government and rejected the possibility of naming his brother Eduardo as foreign minister. In an interview with TV Globo, the senator said the matter was never discussed between them and that he intends to consult his father on political decisions, while maintaining a stance of not offering positions.

item.title: Flávio diz que vai manter o fim da escala 6 X 1 se for eleito
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated he will keep the end of the 6 x 1 workweek if elected, despite initially opposing the constitutional amendment. He justified the shift in stance after hearing widespread worker support for the measure, while pledging to protect labor rights and counteract potential loss of purchasing power. The amendment was approved by the Senate in two voting rounds and enacted in a formal ceremony attended by national leaders.

item.title: Na “Globo”, Flávio cita Huck e Fred Kachar para defender “Dark Horse”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro defended the funding of 'Dark Horse' during a Globo interview, referencing Banco Master sponsorships involving Frederic Kachar and Luciano Huck. He claimed the funds from Daniel Vorcaro were lawful and unirregular, even as Kachar was fired after leaked conversations emerged. Journalist Renata Lo Prete challenged the comparison, noting differences between commercial sponsorships and film financing.

item.title: A promessa feita por Flávio Bolsonaro sobre o fim da escala 6×1
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated in a TV interview that he will not push to change the constitutional amendment ending the 6×1 work schedule, adopting the 5×2 format. He justified this based on worker support and emphasized that the decision was made by Congress. Allies may review the proposal starting in 2026.

item.title: PT pede que TSE não considere “Exército do Lula” vinculado à campanha
item.description: The PT requested the TSE to not consider the 'Exército do Lula' channel as linked to Lula's campaign, arguing there are no resources, support, or guidance from the campaign. The coalition emphasized that the channel is a spontaneous support initiative, protected under new electoral legislation.

item.title: Flávio nega mudar Constituição para permitir candidatura do pai em 2030
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro denied plans to change the Constitution to enable his father, Jair Bolsonaro, to run in 2030, during an interview with Jornal Nacional. He reiterated his support for ending presidential reelection and committed not to seek a second term if elected in October 2026. Flávia also highlighted that he proposed a constitutional amendment prohibiting presidential reelections, reinforcing his stance against retaining power.

item.title: Lula faz campanha em MG e celebra fim da jornada 6x1
item.description: Lula campaigned in Minas Gerais and celebrated the end of the 6x1 work schedule, highlighting benefits for workers. He also criticized Globo over Flávio Bolsonaro's lunch with executives, questioning the network's impartiality.

item.title: Campanha de Lula diz que mudança de tom sobre redução da maioridade atende a nova realidade
item.description: Lula's campaign justified the shift on lowering the criminal age as a realistic strategy aligned with new realities. Aides said the position change had been planned for some time to adopt a more pragmatic stance.

item.title: Datafolha: Para 16% dos eleitores, Brasil não é uma democracia
item.description: A Datafolha survey shows that 16% of Brazilian voters do not consider the country a democracy; 50% say they live under a democratic regime with major flaws, 23% point to minor issues, and only 7% see it as fully democratic.

item.title: Alvo de polêmica, Meta é a empresa que mais arrecadou na eleição do Brasil
item.description: Meta is the top-earning company from election campaigns in Brazil's 2026 elections, facing criticism for allegedly favoring Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign.

item.title: Flávio diz que Nunes Marques também deve estar “abaixo da lei”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro avoided stating whether Kassio Nunes Marques should be investigated, but defended that everyone is below the law. He also proposed judicial reforms during an interview with TV Globo.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Datafolha sobre Lula x Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Datafolha will release a new poll with 2,250 interviews on the race between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for president, with a two-point margin of error. The latest poll showed a technical tie, with Flávio leading 51% to 49%.

item.title: Flavio Bolsonaro promete que, si gana las elecciones, va a declarar la guerra contra el narcotráfico
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro pledged to declare war on drug trafficking and label groups like PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations if elected. He also voiced support for the Americas Shield alliance and stated he would not seek re-election.

item.title: TSE decide manter ordem que proíbe Meta de restringir conteúdo e favorecer candidatos
item.description: The Brazilian Electoral Court unanimously decided to uphold an order preventing Meta from restricting political content and favoring candidates, with a daily fine of BRL 500,000 for non-compliance. The ruling responds to a lawsuit filed by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaign, which accused the platform of reducing post visibility and disabling its ad account. Meta stated it is complying with Brazilian electoral rules and temporarily suspended candidate recommendations.

item.title: Tarcísio liga para Flávio e diz que ele brilhou na entrevista à Globo
item.description: São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas praised Flávio Bolsonaro after his Globo interview, highlighting the candidate's strong performance.

item.title: Flávio descarta irmão como chanceler, deixa em aberto cargo ao pai e cita Lula nas respostas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro ruled out appointing his brother Eduardo as foreign minister and avoided answering whether his father Jair would hold a position in a potential government, while reiterating his criticisms of the PT and supporting the end of presidential reelection. He emphasized reforms and frequently referenced Lula even on issues outside the campaign.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que 'não está no radar' nomear o pai e que Eduardo não será chanceler em eventual governo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated in an interview that he does not plan to appoint his father, Jair Bolsonaro, to a government position and ruled out naming his brother Eduardo as foreign minister. He explained that his father never discussed the matter with him and defended Eduardo, calling him a 'political persecutee'.

item.title: Ministro do TSE rejeita pedido de Flávio Bolsonaro para restringir manifestações em universidades
item.description: The TSE's chief officer, Justice Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, rejected Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) request to restrict political protests in universities, emphasizing academic autonomy, freedom of expression, and the circulation of ideas. The UNE, which supports Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), labeled the move as censorship and reaffirmed its fight for democracy.

item.title: Flávio não descarta dar cargo ao pai e diz que Eduardo não será chanceler
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro did not rule out appointing his father, Jair Bolsonaro, to a government position and ruled out Eduardo Bolsonaro as chancellor.

item.title: Flávio poupa Nunes Marques e ataca Moraes em entrevista no JN
item.description: In an interview with Jornal Nacional, Flávio Bolsonaro attacked Minister Alexandre de Moraes and avoided criticizing Kassio Nunes Marques, maintaining a low-controversy strategy with the former Justice Minister. This approach reflects caution to preserve ties with conservative sectors.

item.title: Flávio nega que mudará fim da 6x1: 'Todos os direitos trabalhistas estão garantidos'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL presidential candidate, stated he will not change the constitutional amendment eliminating the 6x1 work schedule, ensuring all labor rights remain protected.

item.title: Flávio volta a usar cola na mão em sabatina e repete estratégia do pai
item.description: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) once again used a 'cheat sheet' on his hand during a town hall, mimicking a communication strategy previously used by his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The word this time was 'motoboy'. This tactic reinforces the informal and polarizing style of the campaign.

item.title: Entrevista de Flávio à Globo é acompanhada por panelaços em capitais
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's interview on TV Globo was followed by panelaços in several capitals, organized via social media and supported by federal deputy André Janones. The protests reflect a digital strategy linked to Lula's support and mobilization against the PL presidential candidate.

item.title: Flávio diz que não vai desvincular reajuste do mínimo e nem alterar pisos de saúde e educação
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated he will keep the minimum wage adjustment above inflation, without linking it to a percentage and without amending the Constitution to change health and education funding floors. The remarks were made during a TV Globo interview.

item.title: Flávio diz ser contra reeleição: 'Só preciso de um mandato'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated he does not seek re-election as president, saying he 'only needs one term.' He participated in a TV Globo interview conducted by journalist Renata Lo Prete.

item.title: Flávio diz que seu plano fiscal envolve imóveis “abandonados” da União
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro proposed gathering abandoned public properties into a management fund and securitizing them to raise R$ 200 billion, avoiding cuts to pensions and spending on health and education. He also suggested abolishing ministries, using AI against corruption, and securitizing debt, though some proposals involve uncertainties such as oil exploration in the equatorial margin.

item.title: Flávio descarta cargo a Eduardo, mas não ao pai: “Não está no radar”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro will not be appointed as Minister of Foreign Affairs if he wins the presidency. Regarding his father, Jair Bolsonaro, he did not rule out the possibility of a government position, but said the topic was never discussed.

item.title: Flávio é contra fim da 6 X 1 e vai “destruir” Farmácia Popular, diz Lula
item.description: Lula criticized Flávio Bolsonaro, claiming he will 'destroy' achievements like the 6 X 1 work schedule, universities, federal institutes, and the Popular Pharmacy. The president also attacked TV Globo for a lunch meeting with his opponent. Congress approved the proposal ending the 6 X 1 schedule, which Flávio supported after initially criticizing it.

item.title: Moro diz que fim da escala 6x1 não é pauta dos trabalhadores e minimiza efeito para Lula
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL) states that the Senate's approval of the end of the 6x1 workweek scale will not benefit Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) campaign, viewing the measure as a workers' agenda and downplaying its electoral impact.

item.title: Flávio usa relógio do pai, Jair Bolsonaro, em sabatina do JN
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro wore a watch during a Jornal Nacional interview that is identical to one used by his father, Jair Bolsonaro, while in office. His press team confirmed he received the watch in January after being chosen as Jair's electoral successor in 2025. The low-cost timepiece was also worn by Jair during official events such as the 2023 swearing-in ceremony.

item.title: Flávio diz que maior ajuste fiscal do Brasil é a derrota de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that Lula's defeat is Brazil's biggest fiscal adjustment and pledged to keep the minimum wage increase above inflation and support ending the 6×1 work schedule. He denied adopting proposals attributed to his team and accused Lula of spreading information about his administration.

item.title: Empresário que fez repasses a fundo de 'Dark Horse' diz em delação que tentou reaver valores, mas não conseguiu
item.description: Antônio Carlos Freixo Junior, a businessman from Minas Gerais, claimed in a plea bargain that he transferred $12.3 million to the Dark Horse fund at the request of Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master, to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro, unaware of the funds' purpose. He attempted to recover the money upon detecting irregularities but was unsuccessful. The Federal Police challenge the credibility of his account and requested an extension of the investigation from the Supreme Court.

item.title: Lo Prete rebate fala de Flávio sobre Master: “Não está confirmado pela PF”
item.description: Renata Lo Prete refuted Flávio Bolsonaro's claim about alleged bribes involving Lula, stating the accusation is not confirmed by the Federal Police. During a TV Globo interview, Flávio referenced Daniel Vorcaro's reports on 10% kickbacks to release pension fund investments from Banco Master, but was cut off by the host.

item.title: O que está por trás das guinadas de Flávio e Lula durante a campanha
item.description: The electoral race between Lula and Flávio has led both to revise traditional stances, such as supporting the end of the 6×1 work schedule and lowering the age of criminal responsibility, in search of votes in a tightly contested scenario. According to political scientist Rodrigo Prando, these shifts reflect the need to expand electoral appeal in a race defined by the candidates' technical tie.

item.title: Flávio promete corte de 10 ministérios: "Economia de R$ 200 bilhões"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro pledged to eliminate at least 10 ministries and cut spending by R$200 billion annually, echoing his father's administration. In a TV Globo interview, he criticized Lula’s management of state companies and emphasized fighting corruption.
